fix.note: Two blockers. (1) The item branch of resolvePick (build.ts:2797) and resolvePlayItemPassives (play.ts:1222) both `return` unless the option carries `grant.passive`, so innateSpells/focusSpells on an ITEM's effectChoices are discarded; teach the item sink to feed g.innateSpells into chosenInnateGrants the way the feat sink does. (2) The mask adds a cantrip to your PREPARED cantrip list and is inert for anyone who does not prepare arcane or primal cantrips — there is no 'add to prepared cantrips' lane, so granting it as an at-will innate would over-grant. The Uzunjati branch's cantrip is also missing from the imported text and must be sourced before the option list is complete.
